observations: Photo 0 shows an orange LPG gas cylinder with a protective wire mesh around the body and a brass-colored valve/regulator area at the top.
Photo 0 does not show any readable cylinder brand name, serial number, or stamped capacity/weight markings.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the top/valve area and the circular top recess; no clear readable markings (brand/serial/date) are visible.
The cylinder appears intact with no obvious dents/cracks visible in these photos, but the valve condition and leak status cannot be confirmed from images alone.

claims.evidence: No readable capacity/weight marking or stamped identification is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: Photos do not include any test/certification document or leak-test evidence.
Photo 0/1 show the valve area but cannot confirm whether it is newly replaced versus used.

risks.risk: Capacity/weight may not be 12kg (could be different size), which changes value and refill cost.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity/weight (e.g., “12.5kg/12kg”) and serial/ID on the body/top.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown-capacity used LPG cylinder (worst case vs the seller’s stated 12kg).

risks.risk: Leak risk or valve/regulator fault not detectable from photos.
risks.proof: Video of a proper leak test (soap-bubble test at valve connections) and/or a recent cylinder test certificate number/date.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially not guaranteed leak-free (worst case: treat as needs inspection before use).

risks.risk: Valve may be worn/incorrectly fitted even if it looks intact; could fail under pressure.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve/regulator label/brand and the connection type, plus a short run test showing stable pressure/no hissing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used valve condition (worst case: not confirmed new).

risks.risk: Cylinder age/expiry (test date) may be past due, affecting refill eligibility and safety.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped test/expiry date on the cylinder body (and/or certificate).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if test date is not confirmed (worst case: may require retesting).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (12kg) and serial/ID.
Send the cylinder test/certification document (or a photo of the stamped test date) showing it was recently tested.
Send a short video of a soap-bubble leak test around the valve/regulator connections (no bubbles).
Send a close-up of the valve/regulator label/brand and connection details.
response.reason: The photos show an LPG cylinder with a mesh guard, but the key pricing drivers (confirmed 12kg capacity, recent certification/test date, and leak-free status) are not readable or provable from the images. Request the stamped markings and leak-test/certification proof before pricing.
